title: “I’m Not a Robot” (2025 Academy Award Winner) | The New Yorker Screening Room
summary: Victoria Warmerdam's Oscar-winning Dutch short film in which a woman fails a series of Captcha tests and is plunged into a strange new reality. It is a dark, Black Mirror-like sci-fi comedy.
why: HN brings it up in threads about captchas, bots and AI agents as an excellent short film about being a robot.

quote.text: there is an excellent short movie online called "I'm not a Robot".
